name: return38-estimated-tax-penalties
description: P52 Form 2210 and IL-2210: entered underpayment penalties ride BELOW the refund/balance line, so the amount actually paid is net of them in both jurisdictions.
note: Hand-verified: taxable 120,000 -> tax 18,000; wh 15,000 -> due 3,000, plus the 270 Form 2210 penalty = 3,270 net. IL net 144,450 x 4.95% = 7,150; wh 4,000 -> due 3,150, plus 85 IL-2210 = 3,235 net. PLACEHOLDER rules.
